subject: Commercial readiness: vendor intake, PO routing and invoice remittance
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acmehealth.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial readiness: vendor intake, PO routing and invoice remittance

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement and vendor onboarding for the pilot.

Recap of ask from Acme
- Pilot contract for 3 months (up to 50k tokens/day)
- Need vendor packet + SOC 2 evidence and W9 to run through procurement
- Prefer PO-based purchase; invoice remit to centralized AP team (procurement@acmehealth.com)

Our proposed checklist / timeline
1) I’ll send the Redwood vendor packet and SOC 2 summary today (attached).
2) Acme to confirm vendor intake form owner and any additional compliance forms by 3/9.
3) If PO required, target PO issuance by 3/23 so we can start pilot the week of 3/29.
4) Invoices: monthly, net 30; remit-to and AP contact noted in packet.

Open questions we need from you
- Will legal need specific clauses (data segregation, breach notification) beyond the standard SOW?
- Who will be the invoice approver in Accounts Payable (name + email)?
- Does Acme require a customer-specific contract or will a PO against our standard MSA suffice?

Attachments: vendor packet, SOC2 summary, Redwood W9.

I’ll loop in Marissa for the finance/PO flow and Jonas for procurement onboarding if you confirm AP contact.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)] [attachment: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (PDF, 550KB)] [attachment: W9-redwood.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial readiness: vendor intake, PO routing and invoice remittance

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying notes.

- Legal: we’ll need a short addendum for data handling (PII classification + retention). I’ll confirm exact language with Legal by 3/9.
- AP approver: that will be Raj Patel (raj.patel@acmehealth.com). Procurement Ops is on copy.
- Contract: Procurement prefers a PO against supplier standard terms for pilots < $100k; Legal may still request the addendum referenced above.

We’ll kick off vendor intake this week. I’ve attached our vendor intake form (see inbound form link below) — Procurement Ops will start the gating checklist and will reach back if they need additional artifacts.

Inbound vendor form: https://acmehealth.vendorportal/form/ACM-4721

Samantha
Samantha Cho
Director, Strategic Procurement
Acme Health
[Procurement Ops will review the packet and confirm acceptance by 3/9]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial readiness: vendor intake, PO routing and invoice remittance

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Samantha. Noted on the Legal addendum — happy to provide suggested language and a short data-handling exhibit that matches our MSA.

Attached are the documents again and a one-page vendor summary tailored for Procurement Ops (attached as PDF). For clarity on invoicing:
- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears, net 30.
- Remit-to: Redwood Finance, finance@redwood.ai — wire and ACH details included in the vendor packet.
- Invoice references: please have PO number and HubSpot deal id (HubSpot-ACM-4721) on all invoices to speed processing.

Proposed timeline (editable)
- 3/4: Procurement Ops confirms whether extra compliance forms required.
- 3/9: Legal confirms addendum language or approves standard MSA.
- 3/16: Vendor intake accepted in Acme portal (preferred).
- 3/23: PO issued.
- 3/29: Pilot kickoff.

If Procurement Ops requests an expedited review, we can do a short 30-minute intake call with your team (Jonas and Karthik available).

Thanks — looping Marissa for finance cadence and to make sure we have clean invoice routing once PO is issued.

Cheers,
Olga
[attachment: redwood-vendor-packet.pdf] [attachment: vendor-onepager-for-acme.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Ops <procurement@acmehealth.com>; Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial readiness: vendor intake, PO routing and invoice remittance

Hi Procurement team —

Looping in to confirm finance details so AP has everything to route invoices without delay. Quick items we can action immediately: 
- Please confirm the exact PO formatting/fields you require (we’ve seen both: PO# only vs PO# + contract reference).
- Please confirm whether a separate vendor registration (tax forms beyond W9) is required before PO issuance.
- If you accept electronic invoices, please share the remit endpoint and any header fields (e.g., PO, tax ID, vendor contact).

We want to avoid rework once invoices are generated. If helpful, Jonas can share a short sample invoice that matches your preferred schema.

Next steps: if Procurement Ops confirms PO fields by EOD 3/8 we’ll lock the 3/23 PO target. Otherwise we may need a one-week slide.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-invoice-redwood.xlsx]
